title: Scenario runner: an ask-only mode runs 问数 and operations on a supplied built app, so ask models compare on the same build
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M2 row of its milestone table). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 02:10Z: 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」; 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发".

## Mechanism

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts` `runCard` (~948) runs `scratchMode` (author, build, verify, then the Run half) and `templateMode`, which installs a verified build (`--template F` / `templateArtifact`) and then authors an iterate before its Run halves. No mode runs the Run half alone on a supplied build. So two ask models are always graded on two different builds, or on a build their own pass authored, and the ask comparison carries the build's variance.

## Why it matters

The M2 close-out cross matrix (opus build × haiku / sonnet ask) needs the same app under every ask model. Today a difference in 问数 can come from the build, not the ask model, and authoring an app for every comparison costs the most of any step.

## Done when

- A mode (e.g. `--modes ask` with `--template F`) installs the supplied build, seeds it as the Run half does, and runs only the question and operation turns. No authoring turn runs.
- The scorecard and run record mark the mode and name the build's source. Build cells read "supplied", not scored.
- The mode refuses to start without a build. `recorded:` replays it.
- Tests pin that no author turn is asked and that the Run half's grades match scratch mode's on the same build.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`), serial with the other M2 runner cards where files overlap.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue ask-only scenario` → 67 hits; the top ones (#33468 eval seat, #32562, #33596) are unrelated or closed, none an ask-only mode.
